text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! New Year's here is awful exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And I know just what to do at a shrine! Ya toss a coin into the collection box and then give a big round of applause!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? I just figured the gods would enjoy it more if I set the mood.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aaanyway, how 'bout we mosey on over to a shrine?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I end up paying a visit to a shrine with Taiki Shuttle…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I asked the gods to sit back and watch me become Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I put in plenty of work last year, so now we just gotta wait for the announcement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they'll be all smiles when I'm picked for the title! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What did ya pray for, Trainer? Hopin' to become prime minister of Japan?
choice_data_list: I prayed for you to stay healthy.
I prayed for you to keep growing and flourishing.
I prayed for your running to improve.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?! You prayed for me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wait… Did ya know about me pullin' an all-nighter last night?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll nix the night owl act so I can stay healthy and strong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, we wrap up our shrine visit. It won't be long now until the Umamusume of the Year announcement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks! I'm sure I'll shoot up just like a beanstalk!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep growin' and growin' so I can catch hold of my dream with both hands!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I feel power wellin' up inside me all of a sudden! Let's get training, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, we wrap up our shrine visit. It won't be long now until the Umamusume of the Year announcement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Improve? You mean, like, learn some new tricks?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! I think we're on the same page!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm still not very good at breakin' outta the gate, so make sure to include that in your prayer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, we wrap up our shrine visit. It won't be long now until the Umamusume of the Year announcement!
